title: nf-core/seqsubmit pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the sample sheet provided with params.input if params.mode is set to 'metagenomic_assemblies'

sample.errorMessage: Sample must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fasta.errorMessage: FASTA file must be provided and have extension '.fa.gz', '.fasta.gz', '.fna.gz'

fastq_1.errorMessage: FASTQ file(s) must have extension '.fq' or '.fastq' (optionally gzipped); for co-assemblies use semicolon-separated paths
fastq_1.description: Forward reads if paired-end or single-end reads FASTQ file. For co-assemblies, semicolon-separated paths (e.g. run1_R1.fq.gz;run2_R1.fq.gz)

fastq_2.errorMessage: FASTQ file(s) for reverse reads must have extension '.fq' or '.fastq' (optionally gzipped); for co-assemblies use semicolon-separated paths
fastq_2.description: Reverse reads FASTQ file if paired-end. Leave empty for single-end reads. For co-assemblies, semicolon-separated paths (e.g. run1_R2.fq.gz;run2_R2.fq.gz)

coverage.errorMessage: Coverage must be a positive number or empty

run_accession.errorMessage: Accession must be provided and cannot contain spaces
run_accession.description: Accession(s) of the run(s) used to generate the assembly. For co-assemblies, use semicolon-separated values (e.g. ERR000001;ERR000002)

assembler.errorMessage: Assembler must be provided and cannot contain spaces
assembler.description: Name of the assembler software used to generate the assembly

assembler_version.errorMessage: Assembler version must be provided and cannot contain spaces
assembler_version.description: Version of the assembler software used to generate the assembly

errorMessage.anyOf: Either reads or coverage must be provided in the sample sheet for each assembly
